auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [Resend dashboard](https://resend.com/overview)
2. Go to **API Keys** in the left sidebar
3. Click **Create API Key**, give it a name, and copy the key

send_email.name: send_email
send_email.description: Send a text or HTML email

reply_to.description: Email to receive replies on (defaults to sender)

content.description: HTML is only allowed if you selected HTML as type

aiMetadata.description: Sends a single transactional email (plain text or HTML) to one or more recipients via Resend. Use this for one-off messages; the sender address must be on a domain you have verified in Resend. Not idempotent — each call sends a new email.

send_batch_emails.name: send_batch_emails
send_batch_emails.description: Send up to 100 emails in a single API call

emails.description: List of emails to send (max 100). Each email is sent independently with its own recipient, subject, and body.

from.description: Sender address. Use "Name <email@domain.com>" for a friendly name.

content.description: Email body. Use HTML markup if Content Type is HTML.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key to prevent duplicate sends. Must be unique per request, expires after 24 hours, max 256 characters.

aiMetadata.description: Sends up to 100 distinct emails in one Resend API call, each with its own recipient, subject, and body. Use this instead of Send Email when delivering many independent messages at once. Senders must be on verified domains; pass an idempotency key to guard against duplicate batch sends, otherwise each call sends new emails.

get_email_status.name: get_email_status
get_email_status.description: Retrieve the delivery status of a sent email

email_id.description: The ID returned when you sent the email

aiMetadata.description: Looks up the current delivery status and details of a single previously sent email by its Resend email ID. Use this to check whether a specific email was delivered, bounced, or is still scheduled. Read-only and idempotent; requires the email ID returned when the email was sent.

list_emails.name: list_emails
list_emails.description: Retrieve a list of emails sent from your Resend account

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the list of emails sent from the connected Resend account, including their IDs, recipients, subjects, and latest delivery event. Use this to discover email IDs (e.g. to feed Get Email Status, Cancel Scheduled Email, or Reschedule Email) or to audit recent sends. Read-only and idempotent.

cancel_scheduled_email.name: cancel_scheduled_email
cancel_scheduled_email.description: Cancel a scheduled email before it is sent

email_id.description: The ID of the scheduled email to cancel. Use "List Sent Emails" to find it.

aiMetadata.description: Cancels a previously scheduled email so it will not be delivered, identified by its Resend email ID. Use this to stop a future send before its scheduled time. Effectively idempotent — once an email is cancelled, repeating the call has no further effect; only works while the email is still pending.

reschedule_email.name: reschedule_email
reschedule_email.description: Update the send time of a scheduled email

email_id.description: The ID of the scheduled email to reschedule. Use "List Sent Emails" to find it.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time for when to send the email, e.g. 2024-12-01T10:00:00Z

aiMetadata.description: Changes the future send time of an already scheduled email, identified by its Resend email ID. Use this to move a pending send to a new time without cancelling and recreating it. Idempotent when called with the same target time; requires an ISO 8601 date-time and only works while the email is still scheduled.

create_contact.name: create_contact
create_contact.description: Add a contact to a Resend audience

unsubscribed.description: If true, the contact will be unsubscribed from all broadcasts

aiMetadata.description: Adds a new contact (email plus optional name and subscription status) to a specific Resend audience. Use this to grow a mailing list; requires the target audience ID (use List Audiences to find it). Not idempotent — each call creates a new contact, so guard against re-adding the same email.

update_contact.name: update_contact
update_contact.description: Update the name or subscription status of a contact in an audience

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing contact's first name, last name, or subscribed/unsubscribed status within an audience, identified by audience ID and contact ID. Use this to change details or toggle subscription for a known contact. Idempotent — repeating with the same values leaves the contact in the same state.

delete_contact.name: delete_contact
delete_contact.description: Remove a contact from an audience

aiMetadata.description: Permanently removes a contact from a Resend audience, identified by audience ID and contact ID. Use this to delete a subscriber from a list. Effectively idempotent — once removed, repeating the call has no further effect.

list_contacts.name: list_contacts
list_contacts.description: Retrieve all contacts in an audience

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves all contacts in a specific Resend audience, including each contact's ID, email, name, and subscription status. Use this to discover contact IDs (e.g. to feed Update Contact or Delete Contact) or to inspect a mailing list; requires the audience ID. Read-only and idempotent.

list_domains.name: list_domains
list_domains.description: Retrieve all domains added to your Resend account

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves all sending domains configured on the connected Resend account, including each domain's ID, name, verification status, and region. Use this to find a domain ID (e.g. for Verify Domain or Delete Domain) or to check which domains are verified before sending. Read-only and idempotent.

create_domain.name: create_domain
create_domain.description: Add a sending domain to your Resend account and get the DNS records to verify it

name.description: The domain you want to send from, e.g. mail.yourdomain.com

region.description: AWS region for email delivery. Defaults to US East.

aiMetadata.description: Registers a new sending domain on the Resend account and returns the DNS records that must be added to verify it. Use this as the first step in setting up a custom sending domain before triggering verification. Not idempotent — each call attempts to create a new domain entry.

delete_domain.name: delete_domain
delete_domain.description: Remove a domain from your Resend account

aiMetadata.description: Permanently removes a sending domain from the Resend account, identified by its domain ID. Use this to decommission a domain you no longer send from. Effectively idempotent — once deleted, repeating the call has no further effect.

verify_domain.name: verify_domain
verify_domain.description: Trigger a DNS verification check for a domain

aiMetadata.description: Triggers Resend to re-check the DNS records of a domain and update its verification status, identified by domain ID. Use this after adding the required DNS records (from Create Domain) to confirm the domain is ready to send. Safe to call repeatedly — it only re-runs the check.

list_audiences.name: list_audiences
list_audiences.description: Retrieve all contact audiences in your Resend account

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves all contact audiences (mailing lists) in the connected Resend account, including each audience's ID and name. Use this to discover an audience ID needed by contact and broadcast actions (e.g. Create Contact, List Contacts, Create Broadcast). Read-only and idempotent.

create_audience.name: create_audience
create_audience.description: Create a new contact audience in Resend

name.description: A label for this audience, e.g. "Newsletter Subscribers"

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact audience (mailing list) in Resend with the given name and returns its ID. Use this before adding contacts or sending broadcasts when no suitable audience exists yet. Not idempotent — each call creates a new audience even if the name matches an existing one.

delete_audience.name: delete_audience
delete_audience.description: Permanently delete an audience and all its contacts

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes an entire audience and all of its contacts from Resend, identified by audience ID. Use this to remove a whole mailing list; this is destructive and cannot be undone. Effectively idempotent — once deleted, repeating the call has no further effect.

list_broadcasts.name: list_broadcasts
list_broadcasts.description: Retrieve all broadcasts in your Resend account

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves all broadcast campaigns in the connected Resend account, including each broadcast's ID, name, audience, subject, and status (draft, scheduled, sent). Use this to find a broadcast ID (e.g. for Send Broadcast or Delete Broadcast) or to check campaign status. Read-only and idempotent.

create_broadcast.name: create_broadcast
create_broadcast.description: Create a new broadcast email to send to an audience

from.description: Sender address. Must be from a verified domain. Use "Name <email@yourdomain.com>" for a friendly name.

name.description: Internal label for this broadcast. Not visible to recipients.

reply_to.description: Email address recipients will reply to.

preview_text.description: Short summary shown in email clients below the subject line.

content.description: Email body. Use HTML markup if Content Type is HTML.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a draft broadcast email (subject and body) targeting a Resend audience and returns its ID. Use this to prepare a campaign; it only creates the draft and does not deliver anything — pair it with Send Broadcast to actually send. Requires the audience ID and a sender on a verified domain. Not idempotent — each call creates a new broadcast.

send_broadcast.name: send_broadcast
send_broadcast.description: Send or schedule a broadcast email to its audience

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time to schedule the send, e.g. 2024-12-01T10:00:00Z. Leave blank to send immediately.

aiMetadata.description: Sends an existing draft broadcast to its entire audience immediately, or schedules it for a future time, identified by broadcast ID. Use this after Create Broadcast to deliver the campaign. Not idempotent — repeating the call can dispatch the broadcast again; optionally pass an ISO 8601 time to schedule rather than send now.

delete_broadcast.name: delete_broadcast
delete_broadcast.description: Permanently delete a broadcast from your Resend account

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a broadcast from the Resend account, identified by broadcast ID. Use this to remove a draft or unwanted campaign; only broadcasts that have not been sent can be deleted. Effectively idempotent — once deleted, repeating the call has no further effect.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

email_bounced.name: email_bounced
email_bounced.description: Triggers when a selected email or contact event occurs in Resend

events.description: Select one or more event types to subscribe to

aiMetadata.description: Fires when one of the subscribed Resend events occurs, such as an email being sent, delivered, bounced, opened, clicked, complained about, or failing, as well as domain and contact lifecycle events. The payload carries the event type and the affected email, domain, or contact. Subscribe to the specific event types you care about.
